_doc: Painted dusk plates behind every fighter image (final parity client F3, art half): art/blender/common/plates.py. A fighter listed under `fighters` renders portrait.png / splash.png (and every <skin>_portrait.png / <skin>_splash.png) over a painted plate cut from art/out/backdrops/<src>.webp and graded to dusk for its origin (spec.ORIGIN), with the subject lit to match (key / fill / rims). A skin line (the skin id after '<fighter>_') may pick its own painting under `lines`; the origin grade and light stay. Keys and defaults: plates.DEFAULTS (splash_lift: the splash plate's median target over `median`, by painting: 0.02 on every painting but the bright Aubade dawn, so the larger figures of the reframed splashes keep the loading card's p50 >= 70). Loading-card headroom (final parity done:5, refix 1): the card (W2's screens.css .pcard) fades the plate's top into its ink and lays an ink scrim over the foot, so the splash bakes half the top darkening (top_s 0.21, was 0.42) and half the foreground floor (floor_s 0.15), and a card floor toe-lifts each splash's darks until the card window's rows 0.06-0.80 hold luma >= 0.31 (79) at their 20th percentile (card_lo_q / card_lo; plates.card_floor): the dark kits and lines (Ervet Lamplit, Burdam, Sukri, Lisvel Gorgewalk, the Almanac and Highrim lines) are lifted, the bright ones are left as they were; portraits are untouched. Re-render: python3 art/build.py portraits <id> --only splash,portrait (base) and --skins (every skin, from its GLB). Re-compose from the kept subject passes without Blender: python3 art/blender/common/plates.py compose [sids]; measure: python3 art/blender/common/plates.py measure (gate: the 3:5 loading crop and the draft-cell crop at p50 70-110 luma, at most a small share above 200). Integration pass (chars-12: the card floor's toe lifted every splash's black point, whole-image p1 median 15 -> 46, p5-p95 contrast -30, a grey veil over the full splash): the toe keeps a black anchor (toe_black 0.06 of its lift at black, all of it from luma toe_foot 0.27 up), eases to a quarter of its strength toward the left edge (toe_left 0.25, was 0.45: the scenery away from the card) and keeps more of the colour's ratio (toe_chroma 0.7, was 0.5); card_lo 0.31 -> 0.315 holds the card's p50 under the landed screens.css. Whole-image p1 median 46 -> ~25, contrast median 122 -> ~138.
